title: Own It! A Co-op Fest
description: An evening celebrating cooperatives at Broken Clock Brewing Cooperative in Northeast Minneapolis, aimed squarely at people who are new to co-ops or co-op curious. Meet more than 20 local co-ops — credit unions, housing co-ops, food co-ops, worker-owned businesses, energy and interpreter cooperatives — with snacks, coupons, and swag at each table, co-op bingo with prizes, and a cooperative art project. The first 150 people to register get a drink ticket; kid-friendly, with a food truck. Co-hosted by CoMinnesota, Cooperative Development Services, the Minnesota Credit Union Network, the Twin Cities grocery co-ops (Eastside, Rivers, Seward, Wedge), the Minnesota Coalition of Community Owned Real Estate, and Broken Clock. Register on Eventbrite. 4-7pm CT.
